summary: Planned task 726 as a standing script (scripts/generate-decidability-inventory.sh) rather than a /review step, because the deployed .claude/ tree is stale relative to its source store and a script runs from a fresh clone beside the two sources it reads. Six sequential phases (7.25h): source-1 parser with anti-silence guards, the pinned:-cell cross-check against the C2/C14 heredoc baselines, sources 2 and 3, a committed extracted baseline plus --diff and WITHDRAWN carry-forward, documentation and roadmap ownership hand-off, and an end-to-end acceptance run. This dispatch was a restart after a quota interruption; the pre-existing plan file was verified against the format standard and every anchor it cites, and kept.
